title: Office & Commercial Movers in Garden Grove | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Office movers in Garden Grove, booked by the hour: staged relocations, a certificate of insurance for your building and crews seven days a week.
heroTitle: Office & Commercial Movers in Garden Grove
heroSubtitle: Licensed crews, published hourly rates, and a schedule built around your building access hours.

faq.question: Will your crews take a Saturday or Sunday phase?
faq.answer: Yes. Crews work Monday through Sunday between 8AM and 6PM, so a Saturday or Sunday phase is a standard booking rather than a favour. Friday to Sunday is charged at the weekend rate, $135 cash or $145 by card for two movers and a truck, and we do not run night shifts.

faq.question: Do you issue a certificate of insurance for our building?
faq.answer: Yes, for $50, written to the wording and the limits your property manager asks for. We are licensed under USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140. Send the request as soon as you have a date, because some management companies take several days to approve one.

faq.question: Can the move be split across several days?
faq.answer: That is how most office jobs in the city run. One department or one floor moves at a time, and each visit is billed by the hour with a three-hour minimum. If loaded furniture has to stay on the truck between phases, overnight storage is $200.

faq.question: What does an office move in Garden Grove cost?
faq.answer: Two movers with a truck start at $119 cash Monday through Thursday, three movers at $159 and four at $199, with card prices $10 higher and weekend rates above that. Add $30 for fuel and $50 for the certificate of insurance if your building requires one. Travel beyond 10 miles is billed as double drive time.

faq.question: Where does the truck park if our suite has no loading dock?
faq.answer: The city allows a temporary no-parking zone to be posted for moving large equipment or structures, and parking in a posted zone is ticketed like a red curb, so a reserved stretch at the entrance is worth arranging through your manager. Without one, the crew takes the closest legal spot on the block and works with ramps and machine dollies.

faq.question: Can a crew come the same day we call?
faq.answer: Often, yes, when a crew is free. Call 909-443-0004 within our hours, Monday through Sunday, 8AM to 6PM, and we will tell you what is open. A $50 deposit holds the slot and comes off the final bill.
